name: LeadOps | Synthetic lead intake (AI + CRM SIMULATED)

parameters.content:
## Explicit simulation boundary
AI classification uses deterministic JavaScript only. No model, API key, token usage or AI fee.
CRM is a local fictional JSON store. No HubSpot, Salesforce, Airtable or Sheets connection.
Follow-up is an unsent draft; no sender or scheduler exists.

Original implementation. Design references and license notices: docs/SOURCES.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

## Real n8n orchestration
POST /webhook/leadops-intake. Synthetic data and .test emails only.
Validation → normalized email lookup → duplicate gate → simulated classifier → deterministic score → atomic mock commit → draft.
All blocked and error routes converge on an inspectable response with $execution.id. A concurrent duplicate is also stopped at commit.
